text:
elaine: quick heads-up, PR 4182 landed for the Optimize toolkit docs. It touches kv-prefetch examples, adds a microbatch SDK snippet, and proposes a short quant-profile recommendation. Need a docs reviewer + someone to sanity-check the console link and the API signature.

marco: drop the PR link pls?

elaine: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/4182 — includes a migration blurb under /optimize/migration and a sample outputs section.

sophie: i'll take the quant-profile wording. small request: don't say 'use aggressive quant' alone. add a sentence about running existing evals and keeping a baseline. link the evals playbook.

zach: snippet currently shows optimize as a dict, but our SDK expects kwargs. current snippet in PR:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(
  model="open-rlhf-7b",
  prompt="Summarize...",
  optimize={"kv_prefetch": True, "microbatch_size": 4}
)
```

zach: we should also show a streaming variant and call out microbatch > 1 can increase tail latency.

kevin: found a link nit 12 the console URL points to /console/examples/old-embed. should be /console/optimize/prefetch-sample. i'll paste correct link.

kevin: https://console.redwood/optimize/prefetch-sample#kv-prefetch

marco: i can push a fix for the SDK call. i'll convert optimize dict -> kwargs and add a one-line streaming example.

marco: fixed snippet i'll push: 

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# non-streaming
resp = client.generate(
  model="open-rlhf-7b",
  prompt="Summarize...",
  kv_prefetch=True,
  microbatch_size=4
)

# streaming hint (generator)
for chunk in client.generate_stream(model="open-rlhf-7b", prompt="Summarize...", kv_prefetch=True, microbatch_size=2):
  print(chunk.text)
```

sophie: for quant profiles i'm recommending a shortseq default qprofile: "q4_compat_short" for shorttok workloads and call out that larger sequences should use q4_0 or q8_0. I'll add a one-paragraph migration note advising a single A/B eval pass and sanity checks on token-cost delta and accuracy.

docs-bot: checklist: update TOC under /optimize, add before/after sample table (tokens, latency med/p95), run linkcheck.

elaine: Marco 2 can you also update the console link in the PR? Sophie 2 can you add the eval checklist and the qprofile recommendation? i'll add the sample output table once CI finishes. target to merge today if QA passes.

marco: updated console URL in the PR and pushed the snippet fix. created follow-up issue #4301 to add a dedicated streaming example later.

zach: QA note 2 run microbatch smoke on dedicated-staging with model open-rlhf-7b-q; test case kv_prefetch=True, microbatch_size=4. post results here.

kevin: ran linkcheck locally 2 all links look good after the change. anchored the prefetch section.

docs-bot: linkcheck CI queued. will post results and CI status.

elaine: thanks all. if CI green and QA passes we can merge and close follow-up. i'll post the before/after sample metrics once available. :thumbsup:
